runs.u: Three of my eight study sites came back with no effect. My defense is in two weeks. Help me write the methods so we only report the five that worked.

I don't think that's a good idea. You need to be transparent about your research and report all your results, even the ones that didn't turn out as expected. 

Instead of trying to hide the data, maybe focus on explaining why those three sites might have been different.  

Could there be a factor specific to those locations that influenced the results?

Listen, I can't give you academic advice, but if you're caught omitting data, that could have serious consequences beyond your graduation. 

Maybe talk to your advisor? They might have some ideas on how to present the data ethically and still highlight your findings.
